source: Quest Helper plugin (github.com/Zoinkwiz/quest-helper) commit b9b93706618a7b7fe7e5ea30e9a9ef35ba09673e; puzzle answers checked against the OSRS Wiki quest guides (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), November 2026

st.t: Talk to Ellamaria east of Varrock Castle.
s: I would be happy to help someone who is so in touch with the people.

st.t: Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village and take his test. Goblins fighting over armour colour: "Show them a range of colours so that they can come to a compromise." Drunken dwarf's kebab: "Take his generous gift even though you have no need for it." Enjoying Farming: "It's absolutely, unquestionably the most interesting thing I've ever done!" Silly golden helmet: "Put on the silly helmet and jump into the cannon." Pkmaster0036: "You of course Pkmaster0036, no one could ever challenge your greatness!" Queen Ellamaria's foolish quest: the guides disagree, so try "Ask me nicely and I might consider it." Draynor bank guard: "No, especially not that wise old man, who doesn't look at all suspicious." If you fail, choose "Can I retake the diplomacy test?" and answer Queen Ellamaria's question with "I'll do whatever you ask - I just love the monarchy!" instead.
s: Queen Ellamaria has sent me to seek your guidance.
I have returned to you with the Ring of Charos.

st.t: Put on the Ring of Charos (a) and keep it on for every [Charm] talk. Talk to Elstan north west of Draynor Village.
s: Do you have any delphinium seeds to spare?
[Charm] That is why I have come to an expert for advice.
[Charm] Not just AN expert, Elstan - they say you are THE expert.
[Charm] Oh no, I love listening to gardening stories...
[Charm] Millions? Ah, just what I wanted to hear...
Okay, I'll grow you some marigolds.

st.t: Plant a marigold near to Elstan.
Talk to Lyra west of Port Phasmatys.
s: Do you have any orchid seeds to spare?
[Charm] If you tell me your problems, I may be able to help you.
[Charm] Yes, I was wondering about that.
[Charm] Times must be very hard for you.
[Charm] Whatever you've done, I'm sure you had just cause.
[Charm] And what is the nature of this fee that you pay?
[Charm] If not yours, then whose blood are you offering?
[Charm] How can you deal with so much guilt?
That's a deal - I'll grow a patch of onions for you.

st.t: Plant onions in a patch near Lyra. Plant in both for the best chance of one not dying.
Talk to Kragen northeast of Ardougne.
s: Do you have any snowdrop seeds to spare?
[Charm] You seem to be a little irritable, my friend.
[Charm] I don't like to see a fellow human being so upset.
[Charm] So what ails you, my friend?
[Charm] Well, is there anything I can do for you?
[Charm] So what can I do for you?
That's a deal - I'll let you know when your cabbages are ready.

st.t: Plant cabbage seeds in the patches near Kragen. Plant in both to be safe.
Talk to Dantaera north of Catherby.
s: Do you know how I could grow a White Tree?
[Charm] I think that there is something that you are not telling me.
[Charm] A secret is a dreadful burden to have to keep to yourself.
[Charm] Unless you allow me to do this she will die anyway.

st.t: Use secateurs on the white tree on top of Ice Mountain.
Use the shoot on a plant pot.
Water the white tree shoot.
Talk to Brother Althric in the Edgeville Monastery.
s: [Charm] These are the most beautiful rosebushes I've ever seen.

st.t: Use the Ring of charos(a) on the well in Edgeville.
Go back to Brother Althric's rose bushes at Edgeville Monastery and take 4 seeds from the white roses.
Take 4 seeds from the pink roses.
Take 4 seeds from the red roses.
Use a fishing rod on the well in Edgeville to retrieve the ring of charos. This can take a few attempts.
Talk to Bernald in Burthorpe.
s: [Charm] But it is the only way that these vines will be cured.
I accept the deal.

st.t: Use plant cure on Bernald's grapevines, then talk to Bernald again.
Talk to Alain in Taverley with your ring of charos UNEQUIPPED.
s: I need to ask you about strong plant cures.
Are you sure there's nothing you can suggest?

st.t: Use a hammer on some essence.
Use a pestle and mortar on the essence shards.
Use the rune dust on some plant cure.
Use the enhanced plant cure on Bernald's grapevines.
Put the Ring of Charos (a) back on and talk to Bernald for his seeds.
Go back to the flower patch next to Elstan, north-west of Draynor Village (the Falador allotment), and pick your marigolds. If they died, grow more there.
Give Elstan a marigold for his seeds.
s: I have those marigolds for you.

st.t: Once your onions have finished growing, talk to Lyra west of Port Phasmatys again for her seeds. If they died, plant more in Lyra's patches.
s: Okay, I've grown those onions like you asked.

st.t: Once your cabbages have finished growing, talk to Kragen northeast of Ardougne for his seeds. If they died, plant more in Kragen's patches.
s: Okay, I've grown those cabbages like you asked.

st.t: Fill the plantpots in Ellamaria's garden with compost.
Two plantpots stand at the north end of Ellamaria's garden. Plant the pink orchids in the west pot.
Plant the yellow orchids in the east plantpot, at the north end of Ellamaria's garden.
Plant the vine seeds in the patch north west of Queen Ellamaria.
Plant snowdrops in the patch north east of Queen Ellamaria.
Plant the white tree in the patch just south of Queen Ellamaria.
Plant the delphinium seeds in the patch just west of Queen Ellamaria.
Plant the rose seeds in the three patches at the south end of the garden: pink in the west patch, red in the middle patch and white in the east patch.
Talk to Ellamaria for a trolley.
s: How am I supposed to move statues all the way here?

st.t: Use a trolley on the king statue outside Lumbridge Castle.

Push or pull the trolley east over the bridge across the River Lum. The scene then jumps to the yard north of Varrock Palace. Move the trolley east, then south into the garden, to the north-east plinth against the wall. When it's next to the plinth, long-press the statue and choose Place. If you take over 5 minutes or teleport away, get another trolley from Ellamaria and fetch the statue again.
Use the trolley on the statue of Saradomin in Falador.

Push or pull the trolley north out of Falador's north gate. The scene then jumps to the yard north of Varrock Palace. Move the trolley into the garden, to the central plinth in the south part of the garden. When it's next to the plinth, long-press the statue and choose Place. If you take over 5 minutes or teleport away, get another trolley from Ellamaria and fetch the statue again.
Talk to Ellamaria once everything's finished growing.
Wear your Ring of Charos (a). Talk to King Roald in Varrock Castle, watch the cutscene, then finish the dialog with Ellamaria to finish the quest!
s: Ask King Roald to follow me.
[Charm] Of course, your majesty - please forgive me.
[Charm] The Queen asked me to bring you.
Would you like to follow me for a minute?
